svg.data-power-current-max: 7 A at 100 VAC; 2.9 A at 230 VAC
svg.data-cooling: fanless, passive; heatsink in the rear panel
svg.data-optics-sfp: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: the SFP half of each dual-purpose uplink takes 1-gigabit SFP transceivers, fibre or copper, and can be configured as a Virtual Chassis port
svg.data-dual-purpose-uplinks: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: each of the two uplinks is an RJ-45 port and an SFP port, one active at a time; a copper cable in the RJ-45 port makes it active unless the SFP port is linked, and a transceiver in the SFP port always wins unless a media type is configured
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to four EX2200 switches, including EX2200-C, from Junos OS 12.2
